_comment: LinesOfAction locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Never translate board coordinates (a-h, 1-8), piece letters (O, X), the move-format token, or the {board} ASCII grid.

_slots.{side}: The player's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{other}: The opponent's piece letter, either O or X
_slots.{board}: The ASCII rendering of the board; keep as-is
_slots.{coord}: A board coordinate such as b1 or a3
_slots.{from}: The source coordinate of a move, such as b1
_slots.{to}: The destination coordinate of a move, such as b3

player_prompt.intro:
Is tusa Cluicheadair {player_id} ann an geama LinesOfAction.
Tha pìosan agad '{side}', tha pìosan nàimhde '{other}'.
Fòrmat siubhail: `[b1b3]` (co-chomharra tùs gu co-chomharra ceann-uidhe). Siubhail laghail a' gluasad air feadh, suas no sìos, no trasnadh àireamh cheàrnagan co-ionann ris an àireamh pìosan (dath sam bith) anns an loidhne sin. Faodaidh tu leum thar pìosan agad fhèin, ach chan fhaod thu leum thar pìosan nàimhde; ma laigh thu air pìos nàimhde, ghlacas tu e.  Buannaich nuair a tha pìosan uile agad ceangailte ri 8 nàbaidhean.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Feumaidh an cruth a bhith e2e4 (bho,gu co-chomharran).
invalid_move.not_straight_or_diagonal: Feumaidh gluasad a bhith dìreach no diagonal.
invalid_move.wrong_distance: Feumaidh e gluasad air astar co-ionann ri pìosan ann an loidhne.
invalid_move.enemy_blocks: Tha pìos nàmhaid a' cur bacadh air an t-slighe.
invalid_move.destination_own: Ceann-uidhe air a ghabhail le pìos fhèin.
